title: Pottery Trimming Preparation Station
description: One static trimming-preparation scene from the original ceramics scene program. A complete original pottery turntable bench carries a complete upright untrimmed thick-foot clay blank; the complete three-tool trimming kit rests on the existing right-front tabletop, partly under the plate overhang without intersecting the plate or axle. Whole original local POSITION/NORMAL payloads, PBR materials and internal hierarchies are unchanged; only whole-instance translations and one scene-only closed base are new. One scene, zero new independent models. This is an upright work-in-preparation arrangement, not active base trimming, inverted chuck mounting, wheel motion, cutting, clay suitability, equipment compatibility, load, access or safety certification.
